title: How far behind is a calendar of plain years?
description: The Earth takes three hundred and sixty five point two four two two days to go round the Sun. The video finds how many more days the Earth needs after a hundred calendar years of three hundred and sixty five days.
teaching_notes: One idea: each calendar year leaves a small part of a day, and a hundred years multiply that part by a hundred. Watch for children who move the point one place instead of two when they multiply by a hundred.

source: The Earth takes 365.2422 days to go round the Sun. After 100 calendar years of 365 days, how many more days does the Earth need to finish its 100th revolution?
video_script.why: The child can multiply a decimal by a hundred but has not yet used it to see how a small yearly gap grows over many years.
video_script.substitution: the book's own Earth that takes three hundred and sixty five point two four two two days to go round the Sun, against a calendar year of three hundred and sixty five days
video_script.anchor: The Earth takes three hundred and sixty five point two four two two days to go round the Sun, and the calendar year has three hundred and sixty five days
video_script.wrong_answer: two point four two two days
video_script.wrong_move: A common slip moves the point only one place when multiplying by a hundred, so zero point two four two two becomes two point four two two. Multiplying by a hundred moves the point two places.
video_script.payoff_line: The gap after a hundred years is now known.

final_answer.spoken: twenty four point two two days

maths_rules: each calendar year is short by 365.2422 − 365 = 0.2422 days
in 100 years the gap is 0.2422 × 100 days
3 weeks = 21 days, and 20 + 4 = 24 is already more than 21, so the gap is more than 3 weeks
the slip: moving the point one place gives 2.422 days instead of 24.22
video_script.design: One idea: a small yearly gap multiplied by a hundred becomes a large gap. Assumes multiplying a decimal by a hundred. Wrong idea: multiplying by a hundred moves the point one place. The two numbers of days stay all video; the total of twenty four point two two appears only on the answer beat.
